name: Rulebricks
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Los Altos, CA, USA
long_description:
Many workflow builders and automation tools have support for adding logic to your processes, but get complicated quick– to the point where process owners are unable to edit them directly and require specialist services.

Rulebricks separates decision-making logic from your workflows, giving your team a clear visual, spreadsheet-like interface to manage the changing rules that drive your business, and use those rules as API endpoints, visual forms, and in automation tools like Zapier.
one_liner: Add powerful decision-making capabilities to any automated workflow.

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
Prefix is the fastest way to automate processes and centralize data across every modern web tool, allowing rapidly growing teams and organizations to build rich automation flows for tools that may not offer API’s without writing a line of code or, importantly, spending weeks in tutorials.

Primarily focused on financial institutions, Prefix consolidates the highest utility functionality from five-figure RPA platforms into a power tool that outperforms historically expensive and bloated software, lowering the activation energy necessary to start automating and raising the bottom line for boring work on the internet.
